sections.text: Backend Developer, Finlyte (Jun 2024 - Jul 2026). Built Python services for a payments platform, wrote the containerised build with Docker, and owned the automated test suite. Managed releases through a Git branching workflow with peer review.
Self-directed transition into robotics: built an image processing pipeline in Python that tracks objects from a webcam feed, as preparation for perception work.
I am moving from backend engineering into robotics. My Python, testing and version control practice transfers directly; my robotics work so far is self-directed rather than professional.
